# Carcinoma
The world nobody charted until [textlink="the Collapse" link="WFLoreCollapse"] pulled the glare away from it. It is not a planet with life on it. It is a planet that is alive.
Bone fields, meat marsh and scab shores cover the surface. Blood lakes pool in its low places, their banks clotted hard. Ventricles in the ground breathe out carbon dioxide, so the air is poison to anything that did not grow there. Bring your own.
The natives are burrowers and meat spiders, immune to the air and hungry for anything that is not. Pimples on the ground swell and burst when you walk close.
## Home of the Chimera
This is where the [textlink="Chimera" link="WFLoreChimera"] come from. The biomass that smothered Aerumna was grown from a sample of it, taken by someone who has never said how they reached a world nobody had charted.
Pilgrims tell of a [color=#c84040]fountain of life[/color] somewhere on its surface. Few who go looking come back to say whether it is real.
